answer:
The context does not identify a commit. It contains no git history, commit hashes, or log output, only a source snapshot at revision 22a99c140830 (the working tree is clean). So I can't say which commit made the fix.

It does show what the bug was. The test at src/out_json.zig:621-623 says that when the window reaches the end of the line (`e = min(len, s0 + w) = len`), the UTF-8 alignment, before the fix, read `text[len]`. That is a panic in Debug.

The comment at src/out_json.zig:113-115 agrees. It says that with `e == text.len`, reading `text[e]` would go past the slice. That is a panic in Debug/ReleaseSafe and undefined behaviour in ReleaseFast. The current code guards this with `e < ev.text.len` (src/out_json.zig:116).

To find the commit, you would need `git log` or `git blame` output for src/out_json.zig, lines 113-116 or the test at 621.
